pages.title: Armor Progression
pages.text: $(thing)Armor mechanics$(): when you have at least 10 armor points, you gain a permanent Resistance I effect.

pages.title: Copper Armor Set Bonus
pages.text: The first metal armor.$(br2)$(bold)Requirement:$() Craft all copper armor pieces.$(br2)$(bold)Reward:$() 100 XP.
Copper Leggings & Boots. Full set → Resistance I.

pages.title: Mithril Armor Set Bonus
pages.text: The Mithril Chestplate doubles your natural health regeneration rate. $(important)All set pieces must be crafted on a Mithril Crafting Table (or higher).$()
Mithril Leggings & Boots. Full set → near invulnerability.

pages.title: Ancient Metal Chainmail
pages.text: Dropped by $(item)Longdead$() — $(thing)not craftable$().$(br2)Uncraft into $(item)Ancient Metal Nuggets$() to obtain ingots for crafting the Diamond Crafting Table.

pages.title: Continue Learning
pages.text: Learn about weapons, special items, and creatures.
